title: Ronaldo joins Portugal training ahead of sixth World Cup appearance
content: Ronaldo joins Portugal training ahead of sixth World Cup appearance Ronaldo joins Portugal training ahead of sixth World Cup appearance Portuguese star Cristiano Ronaldo hit the training pitch as he readies for his sixth World Cup appearance. Portugal will play Chile in a friendly, before heading to the US for their first World Cup match on June 18. Punters say Portugal is a dark-horse contender to take the title. Published On 6 Jun 2026
